02_design.scientific_parameters: Explicit draft choices require review and freezing before execution

settings.method: paired TNFA pose conservation and IPSAE product ranking
settings.scope: All complete indexed human/mouse pairs at frozen snapshot; incomplete full cohorts remain explicit. Twenty design slides plus four cohort plot slides.
settings.ipsae: Symmetric Dunbrack v4 residue-specific d0 best D-to-A/B/C, PAE<10 A, contact diagnostics15 A; human/mouse arithmetic mean.
settings.ranking: mean_IPSAE times binder_pose_TM_target_aligned, descending full precision then candidate_id ascending. Top 5 per cohort.
settings.binder_pose_tm: Fixed identical-sequence binder CA correspondence under target-only proper Kabsch fit. All human/mouse homologous target CA sites across trimer; enumerate six protomer copy permutations. Among fits within0.1 A of best target RMSD take greatest binder pose TM. d0=max(0.5,1.24*(L-15)^(1/3)-1.8) for L>15, else0.5. No binder fitting.
settings.whole_complex_tm: USalign Mouse vs Human, -mol prot -mm1 -ter1 with explicit selected chain map. Second TM score normalized to Human full complex. Separate diagnostic.
settings.dockq: DockQ2.1.4 symmetric average Human-reference and Mouse-reference comparison, native atom identities retained. Collapse mapped trimer to receptor R and binder to D; explicit homologous residue-number mapping including gaps, no_align=True. Only binder–trimer interface, no target–target score domination. Contact5 A, interface10 A, native references are predictions. Fixed copy map chosen by target-aligned binder pose TM.
settings.preservation: Read-only native structures. New immutable score output and temporary adapters only. No changes to predictions or GPU recovery settings.

runtime_dependencies.installation: Isolated run-specific --target library. Existing Boltz2 environment remains intact. Official PyPI packages with pip report hashes.

settings.implementation_change: Copy only residue/chain data for DockQ adapters, excluding parent model references. Avoid repeated deep copies of the whole complex; metric definitions unchanged.
